content_fields.title: Verify that cgroup usage is confirmed (Docker)
content_fields.description: Remove privileged mode and SYS_ADMIN so the container cannot reconfigure cgroups, and confirm the cgroup parent.
content_fields.finding: Running privileged with SYS_ADMIN gives the container control over cgroup configuration.
content_fields.required_fix:
# docker-compose.yml
  web:
    privileged: false
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    cgroup_parent: /restaurant.slice
criteria: SYS_ADMIN is not granted to any container.
The cgroup parent is set explicitly and limits are enforced by it.
